settings.outputLanguageDescription: Language used for insight names, recommendations, summaries, and /ask answers. SQL, identifiers, and JSON keys stay in English regardless of choice.
settings.blurbModelDescription: The LLM used during schema indexing to generate the per-table descriptions that get embedded into Qdrant. Override here to pick a cheaper / faster model. Changes apply to the next re-index.
settings.profileDescription: Help the AI understand your domain. This context improves insight quality.
settings.validationSwitchLabel: Run validation on insights and recommendations
settings.validationSwitchDescription: When on, every discovery runs the verifier + refuter pair against each insight and recommendation, surfacing per-claim evidence in the dashboard. When off, future discoveries skip validation and stamp each item as 'Disabled' — individual items can still be validated manually from their detail pages.
settings.smartOverflowSwitchLabel: Smart overflow handling for large evidence
settings.smartOverflowSwitchDescription: When the evidence selected for an analysis area exceeds the model's context budget, keep more of it by de-duplicating near-identical queries, tightening per-step detail, and leaving a short note of what was examined but not shown — instead of simply dropping the lowest-scored steps. Only affects runs that would otherwise overflow, so it has no effect on large-context models. Recommended on.
settings.clarifyingQuestionsSwitchDescription: When on, after a discovery run the agent asks you a short list of questions about anything it was uncertain about (opaque codes, ambiguous columns, findings it couldn't verify). Your answers are saved as notes and fed into the next run, so the analysis keeps improving. Grounded questions only — a clean, confident run asks nothing. On by default.
settings.reflectionSwitchDescription: When on, after each run the agent consolidates it into a persistent per-project ledger — coverage of what's been explored, findings kept with their metric and SQL and a status, and a queue of what to investigate next — and the next run builds on that instead of starting fresh. Off by default at the deployment level; where enabled, this opts an individual project in or out. On by default.
settings.reasoningSwitchDescription: Turn on for reasoning models (e.g. Kimi, qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, Ollama thinking models). Off by default. When on, the model gets extra window-budgeted output headroom during exploration so a long hidden chain-of-thought doesn't truncate the step, and discovery requests reasoning on every call — providers that support native thinking act on it (capability-checked); others simply get the headroom. Leave off for non-reasoning models.
settings.askSuggestionsSwitchDescription: When on, opening an insight or recommendation shows a few AI-generated starter questions you can ask about it. This makes an automatic LLM call the first time each item is opened (results are cached), so turn it off to avoid the extra requests. On by default.
settings.recommendationEligibilityDescription: Which validation verdicts qualify an insight for recommendation generation. Default is Confirmed + Supported (only positively-validated insights). Add Partial / Unverifiable when the warehouse can't self-verify (e.g. no temp-table permission) but you trust the analysis. Rejected means the evidence contradicts the insight — include with caution. Insights whose validation didn't run stay eligible regardless. Clearing the selection reverts to the default.
settings.verdictOption_confirmed: Confirmed — evidence directly equals the claim
settings.verdictOption_supported: Supported — evidence consistent with the claim (default positive)
settings.verdictOption_partial: Partial — some claims covered, or coverage incomplete
settings.verdictOption_unverifiable: Unverifiable — verifier could not produce evidence (caution)
settings.debugLogsSwitchLabel: Show debug logs during discovery and indexing
settings.debugLogsSwitchDescription: Adds a verbose per-query + per-LLM-call tail to the live discovery panel, and a live agent-stderr tail to the schema-index panel on this project's page.
settings.debugLogsFootnote: Local-browser preference — not shared with other users and not saved on the project.
settings.schemaCacheDescription: The agent caches the discovered warehouse schema so re-runs skip the full catalog pass. Clearing the cache also drops the Qdrant index and resets the project to needs indexing — discovery will be blocked until a fresh reindex completes.
settings.cacheInfoNone: No cache yet — next indexing run will discover schemas from the warehouse.
